name: Dungeon Crawl
hook: Clear it room by room. Loot as a team.
how: Each floor is a chain of rooms full of monsters. Clear a room to open the next door, grab the loot before your friends do, and find the stairs to go deeper.
controls: WASD or arrows and Space, or the thumb stick and Attack button
uses: The host's browser runs the monsters, the loot drops and the room clears; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
The deepest floor each player reached.
AI companions fight beside you until enough people join.
Everyone sees the same dungeon, monsters and swings as they happen.
ideas: Add a mage and an archer class
